[id 12]
Annual profit per year: (7 lemons * $1.5) - $3 = $10.5 - $3 = $7.5
Cost to plant: $90
Years to break even: 90 / 7.5 = 12

[id 13]
Let x be the initial number of vacuum cleaners.
Sold at green house: x/3
Sold at red house: 2
Sold at orange house: (x - x/3 - 2)/2 = (2x/3 - 2)/2 = x/3 - 1
Remaining: 5
Equation: x - (x/3 + 2 + x/3 - 1) = 5
x - (2x/3 + 1) = 5
x/3 - 1 = 5
x/3 = 6
x = 18
